content.short: Rise Wallet is a high-performance, non-custodial wallet for Aptos and Sui focusing on security and seamless UX.
content.description:
Rise Wallet is a leading self-custodial digital asset manager built natively for the high-performance Aptos and Sui blockchains. Developed by the Solrise Research team, the wallet is designed to provide users with a secure and intuitive gateway to the decentralized web. Rise supports advanced features such as real-time NFT management, integrated DEX aggregation for optimal swap rates, and deep integration with the broader Move-based dApp ecosystem. The platform focuses on delivering a responsive and professional-grade user experience typical of centralized applications.

By leveraging the high throughput and sub-second finality of its underlying chains, Rise Wallet ensures near-instant transaction settlement and robust cryptographic security. The wallet is designed for both retail and institutional participants who seek total sovereignty over their digital capital and identity. As a primary portal for the next generation of decentralized finance and gaming, Rise is dedicated to providing the essential infrastructure needed for mass adoption in the rapidly evolving Web3 landscape.
content.meta: Rise Wallet is a premier non-custodial wallet for the Aptos and Sui blockchains, featuring secure asset management and dApp interaction.
